incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered: RED-A - runtime-proxy error-rate alert (INC12345)

pagerduty: New alert for INC12345 - conditions met: error_rate > 3% (1m)

samir: acked. I'm on it.

jess: adding context — any deploys in the last 15m?

samir: yes, canary runtime-proxy@rev-43 rolled 10m ago to us-west. spinning up checks now.

samir: quick grafana query:
```
sum(rate(runtime_proxy_errors_total[1m])) by (region)
```
seeing a sharp spike in us-west, error rate peaked 3.8% at ~1919999990.

lina: paging noise? if it's a brief spike we can silence PD for 10m: `/pd silence INC12345 10m --reason "noisy transient, investigating"`

ops-sre: agree — sounds like flapping after canary. If rollback is quick we can avoid escalation.

samir: starting rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime-proxy --to-revision=42 -n prod`

devops-bot: Rollback job started: job-98765

devops-bot: Rollback job completed: job-98765 — pods returning to rev-42

samir: errors dropping — 3.8% -> 0.25% over ~90s. p95 and p99 stable. No customer-facing errors reported in Sentry.

pagerduty: Alert INC12345 auto-resolved — condition cleared.

jess: silenced PD for 10m as planned. will follow up in morning retro. @maya I can hand off — leaving notes in #oncall-handoffs.

maya: taking handoff, thanks. please add short TL;DR and link to graphs.

lina: TL;DR for handoff: transient error spike in us-west after canary rev-43; rollback to rev-42 recovered traffic; likely health-check mismatch causing 1-2m flapping. Action items: 1) widen eval window from 1m->3m for this alert, 2) add deploy mute window rule, 3) add a canary health-check verification step to rollout pipeline.

ops-sre: created ticket INF-2102 with the three action items.

samir: marking incident as noisy transient. No customer impact escalations. closing thread :white_check_mark:
